why_boundary: Zero is below the eligibility minimum
expected_behavior: Reject sign-up because the user is under 18; do not create an account.

why_boundary: One year below the age threshold
expected_behavior: Reject sign-up because users must be at least 18.

why_boundary: Exact eligibility threshold
expected_behavior: Accept the age value if the other fields are valid.

why_boundary: One year above the age threshold
expected_behavior: Accept the age value if the other fields are valid.

why_boundary: Negative age is invalid
expected_behavior: Reject with an age validation error; do not create an account.

why_boundary: Very large value probes supported age bounds
expected_behavior: Reject values outside the supported numeric range; define a reasonable maximum age policy and validate without overflow.

why_boundary: Fractional age tests whether age must be a whole number
expected_behavior: Require a whole-number age; reject fractional values rather than rounding.

why_boundary: Missing age cannot establish eligibility
expected_behavior: Require age and show a validation error; do not create an account.

why_boundary: Empty email is missing a required identifier
expected_behavior: Require a non-empty valid email address; do not create an account.

why_boundary: Whitespace-only email is effectively empty
expected_behavior: Trim surrounding whitespace and reject if no valid address remains.

why_boundary: Plus-addressing is a common valid email form
expected_behavior: Accept if supported by the application's email validation; preserve the address consistently.

why_boundary: Single-label domain tests the application's email policy
expected_behavior: Define policy: require a fully qualified email domain by default and reject addresses without one.

why_boundary: Consecutive dots test malformed local-part handling
expected_behavior: Reject malformed email syntax with a clear validation error.

why_boundary: Surrounding spaces may cause avoidable validation failures
expected_behavior: Trim surrounding whitespace before validation and consistently store the normalized address.

why_boundary: Very long address may exceed supported format or storage limits
expected_behavior: Enforce documented email length limits and reject excess input clearly; do not truncate into a different address.

why_boundary: Internationalized domain represented in ASCII punycode tests domain handling
expected_behavior: Accept or reject according to documented international-domain support; normalize consistently and avoid misidentifying the domain.

why_boundary: Markup-like text is untrusted input for email validation
expected_behavior: Reject invalid email syntax and treat all submitted values as text; never interpret or execute markup.

why_boundary: Empty password is below the minimum length
expected_behavior: Reject and explain the password requirements without exposing submitted password text.

why_boundary: Seven characters is one below the minimum
expected_behavior: Reject because the password must contain at least 8 characters.

why_boundary: Eight characters is the exact minimum and includes a number
expected_behavior: Accept the password if the other sign-up fields are valid.

why_boundary: Nine characters is above the minimum and includes numbers
expected_behavior: Accept the password if the other sign-up fields are valid.

why_boundary: Sixty-four characters is the exact maximum and includes numbers
expected_behavior: Accept if password length is counted according to the documented character-count policy.

why_boundary: Sixty-five characters exceeds the maximum
expected_behavior: Reject because the password must be no more than 64 characters.

why_boundary: Password meets minimum length but has no number
expected_behavior: Reject because the password must contain at least one number.

why_boundary: Trailing space is a valid character but may be mishandled by trimming
expected_behavior: Define policy: preserve password whitespace exactly and count it as a character; accept if the remaining requirements are met.

why_boundary: Non-ASCII character tests character counting and encoding
expected_behavior: Accept if length is 8 to 64 under a documented Unicode counting rule and at least one number is present; preserve securely without lossy conversion.

why_boundary: Emoji may count differently as code points, grapheme clusters, or UTF-16 units
expected_behavior: Define and consistently enforce password character counting; accept only if the resulting length is within 8 to 64 and a number is present.

why_boundary: Punctuation-rich string is test input for safe handling, not an instruction
expected_behavior: Treat as a literal password; validate length and number requirement, store using secure password handling, and never execute or log the value.

why_boundary: Null password is missing a required credential
expected_behavior: Reject with a validation error; do not create an account or log the password.

why_boundary: Valid threshold age combines plus-addressing and a minimum-length password starting with spaces
expected_behavior: Apply the documented email and password policies independently; preserve password characters and accept if both fields validate.

why_boundary: Fourth prior failure is one attempt below the lock threshold
expected_behavior: Allow the failed attempt response and lock the account when the fifth failure is reached.

why_boundary: Account has reached the five-failure lock threshold
expected_behavior: Lock the account for 15 minutes; reject further login attempts during the lock period.

why_boundary: Repeated attempts while locked test enforcement of the lock state
expected_behavior: Keep the account locked for the full lock period; do not extend or shorten it unless a documented policy says otherwise.

why_boundary: Attempt occurs one second before the 15-minute lock expires
expected_behavior: Deny login because the 15-minute lock period has not elapsed.

why_boundary: Attempt occurs exactly at the lock expiry boundary
expected_behavior: Allow login attempts after the full 15 minutes have elapsed, subject to normal credential validation.

why_boundary: Attempt occurs just after lock expiry
expected_behavior: Allow login attempts after expiry, subject to normal credential validation.

why_boundary: Lock period crosses midnight
expected_behavior: Calculate the full 15-minute interval across the date boundary using an unambiguous time basis.

why_boundary: Equivalent timestamps use different time-zone offsets
expected_behavior: Compare instants correctly across offsets; consider the lock expired exactly 15 minutes after the lock began.

why_boundary: Successful login between failures tests whether failures reset
expected_behavior: Define policy: reset the failure counter after a successful login; lock only after five failures since that reset.

why_boundary: Six rapid failures test threshold crossing and repeated lock behavior
expected_behavior: Lock on the fifth failure and keep the account locked; do not create multiple conflicting lock timers.

why_boundary: Concurrent failed logins can race the counter update
expected_behavior: Count failures atomically so reaching five reliably locks the account for 15 minutes.

why_boundary: Threshold-counting attempt uses a syntactically valid account identifier and wrong password
expected_behavior: Count the failed authentication consistently and lock the account on the fifth failure; do not reveal whether the account exists.
